title: Ben Horowitz - "Your ONLY job is Right Product, Right Time"

reader_summary.headline: You people are doing everything but your job, you're writing these requirements, you're pitching customers, you're doing all this stuff.
reader_summary.overview: You people are doing everything but your job, you're writing these requirements, you're pitching customers, you're doing all this stuff, it's a lot of work. But your job is right product, right time. And if you don't give me the right product at the right time, I'm going to fuck what you do.

key_points.text: Story of the company is, why do we exist?
key_points.evidence_quote: Story of the company is, why do we exist?

key_points.text: Why should you invest in this company?
key_points.evidence_quote: Why should you invest in this company?

key_points.text: If you know the why, I don't even have to tell you the why.
key_points.evidence_quote: If you know the why, I don't even have to tell you the why.

key_points.text: Foundry's spend time on everything, hiring, fundraising, product specs, customer conversations.
